newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom rises on dividend trade.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom rises on dividend trade.

text.p: Shares in Portugal Telecom rose on the final day of trading before the stock goes ex-dividend and dealers expected further gains during the session.
By 1100 GMT Telecom had climbed 37 escudos to 6,370 on volume of 373,281 shares.
"Telecom is adjusting to its higher New York close yesterday and it could keep climbing since today is the last trading day for investors who want to receive (1996) dividends," said one trader.
Dealers said the share's next resistance level was 6,400 escudos.
They said the fact that shares in Lisbon were cheaper than in New York, where the stock is already ex-dividend, would allow room for arbitrage.
Telecom, which is due to pay a dividend of 122 escudos on April 30, closed up $0.625 at $36.375 on Wall Street.
